review_scope: New focused manuscript check §3.2/§4/§5/Fig11 plus complete reads of author CSVs and relevant README/code; no model training
dictum: Exact author-published single-network results exist; a contextual candidate is calculable from a paired UCR2018/128 source-local two-variant pool. The current fixed P9 rule does not define this new aggregation/pool, so do not silently overwrite it.

candidate.estimand: Mean error of a single trained network, estimated by equal averaging of all five individual runs; no averaging of predicted class probabilities
candidate.metric: Mean classification error (1-accuracy), equal weight per dataset and per individual run
candidate.split_evidence: Author files label the same UCRArchive_2018 and exact same 128 dataset names. Original §§4/6.6 use archive-provided train/test splits. Exact membership/checksums for the 128 saved runs are not in the CSV and were not reproduced.
candidate.pool: All two distinct reported model variants in the author UCR128 raw results: single-network repeated estimate; default InceptionTime ensemble(5). All 128 datasets, no performance-selected subset or best run.
candidate.calculation_type: New deterministic arithmetic from exact author CSV cells, not a number printed in the article

readme_evidence.locators: Results lines45–55: ensemble128 link at50; explicitly identifies individual-five-runs file at55.

original_evidence.finding: Default InceptionTime averages predicted class probabilities of five networks. This differs from averaging the test accuracies of individual networks.
InceptionTime(1) is single network; no exact single accuracy/MPCE numeric table supplied.
Archive supplies train/test split; authors acknowledge possible benchmark overfitting.

csv_85_check: 1020 rows, 85 datasets ×12 classifier labels. Every label is default or hyperparameter-variant ensemble(5); none identifies single network. Cannot fill single UCR85/MPCE from that CSV.
limitations: Two-model pool yields only endpoint scores 0 and1; no global calibration or claim of state-of-the-art.
Only single versus ensemble on author raw128 result pool; cannot reconstruct full Figure11 six-ensemble pool from the exposed CSVs.
Result is classification context, not cryptocurrency volatility or E2 forecasting effectiveness.
CSV does not contain class counts needed for MPCE; do not call mean classification error MPCE.
Same named archive and dataset set plus archive-split description establish source-local reported comparison; exact test-instance identity or equal compute/HPO are not independently verified.
Mean across five single-network scores estimates repeat performance; it is not the accuracy of one fixed fitted model or the ensemble(5).
P=0 here means the larger mean loss among these two variants; it is not evidence of low absolute effectiveness.
recommended_integration: Publish as explicit retrospective P10/UCR128 raw-author-results extension, freeze this two-variant pool and loss definition, retain P9/P_original unchanged. If current rule is required verbatim with no extension, keep P null.
publication_title: InceptionTime: Finding AlexNet for Time Series Classification
raw_data_preservation: Original author CSV bytes preserved and independently matched against returned Git blob SHA (git-object SHA1); original column values/order/newline retained.

sota_pool_check.reason: Same archive name and128 datasets, but identity of preprocessing/splits of historical runs not proven. dl-4-tsc utils/utils.py current lines74–99 and130–159 normalizes each series; exposed InceptionTime loader has no UCR2018 branch. No cross-repository merge.
